summary_1line: Krishna recounts Abhimanyu’s heroic death to his grieving family, leading to intense lamentation and Kunti’s attempt to console Subhadra with hope of Abhimanyu’s unborn heir.

image_candidates.scene_text: Subhadra collapses to the ground in a swoon as Krishna is urged to recount the death of her son Abhimanyu.
Krishna solemnly narrates Abhimanyu’s final stand while the aged Vasudeva, overcome with grief, laments beside him.
The grieving women surround Subhadra and Uttara as Kunti consoles them, reminding them of the unborn child who will continue Abhimanyu’s line.
